title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Joshua 1: Yahweh's charge to Joshua after the death of Moses, and the people's answer.

questions.text: Whose servant is Joshua the son of Nun called in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' servant, after the death of Moses.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he had given to Joshua?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses."

answers.text: Every place that the sole of his foot would tread on
Every city whose king he defeated
Every land he could see from the mountain
Every well that he would dig

questions.text: Which great river is named as part of the border?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 names the border as reaching "to the great river, the river Euphrates."

questions.text: Complete Yahweh's promise: "As I was with Moses, so ..."
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you."

answers.text: "I will give you a new name"
"you will speak with me on the mountain"

questions.text: What was not to depart from Joshua's mouth?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth."

questions.text: When was Joshua to meditate on the book of the law?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he was to meditate on it day and night, to observe to do all that is written in it.

answers.text: At the end of every seven years

questions.text: Within how many days were the people to pass over the Jordan?
questions.explanation: The officers were to tell the people to prepare food, "for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan."

questions.text: Which tribes were told their wives, little ones and livestock would stay in the land beyond the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, whose families and livestock would live in the land Moses gave them beyond the Jordan.

answers.text: The tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin
The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
The tribes of Ephraim, Dan and Naphtali
The tribes of Levi, Issachar and Zebulun

questions.text: Until when were these armed men to help their brothers?
questions.explanation: They were to help their brothers until Yahweh had given them rest and they had also possessed their land; then they could return.

answers.text: Until Joshua had grown old and died
For seven years after crossing the Jordan
Until the walls of Jericho were rebuilt
Until Yahweh had given their brothers rest

questions.text: What did the people say should happen to anyone who rebels against Joshua's commandment?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says whoever rebels against his commandment and does not listen to his words "shall himself be put to death."

answers.text: He shall be put to death
He shall be sent back across the Jordan
